name: AI Particle Simulator
tagline: A 3D swarm simulator with gesture controls
description: A massive Three.js particle playground from Casberry. Feed a plain-language idea to any AI model and paste the generated code back in to reshape 20,000+ particles into fractals, attractors and fields — then export the formation as React or vanilla JS, or as a GLB, OBJ, PLY or wallpaper render. Rotate with one finger, zoom with an open palm, and tune the swarm from a live control panel.
